 Alterna Festival 
 Alterna Festival 2027 announces Bob Vylan, Lendakaris Muertos and Moscow Death Brigade: 2 and 3 July in El Bonillo
 Redacción ModoFestival · Editor: Pau 
 20 Nov 2026, 18:30 
 A 3-minute read 
 Alterna Festival 
 Follow us on Google 
 In short
 Alterna Festival 2027 will take place on Friday 2 and Saturday 3 July in El Bonillo (Albacete) , with a first preview of eight names spanning Spanish punk, rap and hardcore. 
 Bob Vylan is the line-up's international draw : the British duo comes to the province after pulling out of Viña Rock 2026. 
 The two-day pass now costs €55 on Enterticket, with free camping included, after the 48-hour offer at €50 came to an end. 
 The line-up is not yet complete : the festival website has six slots still to be revealed and has not published the day-by-day split or set times. 
 El Bonillo already knows who opens its 2027 line-up. Alterna Festival will return to the Albacete town on Friday 2 and Saturday 3 July 2027 with Bob Vylan , Lendakaris Muertos , Iseo & Dodosound , Sons of Aguirre & Scila , Kaos Urbano , Moscow Death Brigade , Periferia and Nerve Agent . The announcement was published on Wednesday 18 November on the official website, two hours before passes went on sale.

 Alterna Festival 2027 line-up: Spanish punk, rap and hardcore
 These are the first eight names of this edition:
 Bob Vylan , a British punk and rap duo.
 Lendakaris Muertos , punk from Navarre with satirical lyrics.
 Iseo & Dodosound , the reggae and electronic project that provides the least guitar-driven note.
 Sons of Aguirre & Scila , who already played El Bonillo in 2026 and who next summer will also play Leturalma, in Letur , another festival in the province.
 Kaos Urbano , street punk veterans who celebrated thirty years in 2026.
 Moscow Death Brigade , who mix hip hop and hardcore punk.
 Periferia .
 Nerve Agent , who return after appearing at the 2026 edition and whom the festival presents as part of their farewell tour.
 The announcement follows the line of the 2026 edition, which brought together Soziedad Alkoholika, Boikot, Dubioza Kolektiv and Narco: punk and metal as the backbone, with the odd counterpoint of mestizo fusion. It is also very similar to that of Juergas Rock 2027 in Adra, presented nine days earlier: five of the eight names, from Bob Vylan to Periferia, are also confirmed for the Almería festival, which takes place a month later. For anyone torn between the two, El Bonillo is the shorter option, at two days; Adra offers four.
 Alterna Festival crowd at a previous edition. Image: Alterna Festival. Bob Vylan, the international name after leaving Viña Rock
 This is not the first time the duo has appeared on a line-up in the province. In December 2025, a day after Viña Rock announced them as one of the headliners of its 2026 edition, they announced that they would not play the Villarrobledo festival. According to elDiario.es, they were thereby joining the boycott by bands over the festival's links to the investment fund KKR.
 Alterna Festival 2027 tickets: €55 pass with camping
 Official sales are on Enterticket , linked from the festival website. The two-day pass went on sale at midday on Wednesday 18 at €50, with no booking fees , as a special 48-hour offer . That offer has now ended: on the afternoon of Friday 20, Enterticket listed it as closed and was selling the first-release pass at €55 . The festival has not said how many tickets are in this tier or how much the next one will cost.
 The pass includes entry to the site on both days, access to the Rolling Cyrcus activities area and free camping , next to the site, which opens the day before the festival. There was an earlier sale: a €40 blind pass released in July with no names confirmed, which is sold out.
 Under-16s may enter accompanied by their parent or guardian and with a signed authorisation; the ticketing platform also requires parental permission for all under-18s.
 What is still to be announced
 The official website shows six more slots on the line-up, still unnamed. Nor have the day-by-day split, the set times or the exact location of the site been published; in 2026 it was the Recinto Ferial Quijote. Registration for the Rolling Cyrcus activities and information on cashless payment will come later, according to the organisers.
 Dates, typical weather in El Bonillo and accommodation options can be found on the Alterna Festival page .
